scripts.lint:pack:all: bun run lint:pack:publint && bun run lint:pack:types && bun run lint:pack:exports
scripts.lint:pack:publint: sh -c 'for d in packages/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; (cd "$d" && bunx publint --pack npm --strict --level warning) || exit 1; done'
scripts.lint:pack:types: sh -c 'for d in packages/precompiles packages/registry packages/sei-global-wallet packages/mcp-server; do (cd "$d" && bunx attw --pack . --profile esm-only) || exit 1; done'
scripts.release:internal: bun run build && bunx changeset && bunx changeset version --snapshot internal && bunx changeset publish --no-git-tag --snapshot --tag internal
